title: Enumeration-Guided Training of Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Safety Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2610.27870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis offers formal safety guarantees for control systems, but training accurate neural certificates remains difficult, particularly when unsafe regions are hard to characterize. We propose a verification-guided training framework that addresses this by using probabilistic enumeration of safety constraints to detect forward-invariance violations, i.e., states where the learned certificate incorrectly classifies unsafe behavior. This produces a compact, targeted set of counterexamples that more precisely captures the failure boundary than inputs generated by standard adversarial attack methods. Crucially, using this representation to fine-tune a pretrained HJ value function yields larger certified regions and reduces certification time across all tested benchmarks. translated_title: 基于枚举引导的神经Hamilton-Jacobi安全证书训练
translated_abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析可为控制系统提供形式化安全保证，但训练精确的神经证书仍然十分困难，尤其当不安全区域难以刻画时。我们提出了一种验证引导的训练框架，通过使用安全约束的概率枚举来检测前向不变性违反，即学习到的证书错误分类不安全行为的状态。这产生了一个紧凑且具有针对性的反例集合，相比标准对抗攻击方法生成的输入，能更精确地捕捉失败边界。关键的是，利用这种表示来微调预训练的HJ值函数，可在所有测试基准上获得更大的认证区域并缩短认证时间。我们进一步引入了一种基于精炼证书的屏蔽机制，以便在部署时强制执行安全约束。
tldr: 提出一种验证引导的训练框架，通过安全约束的概率枚举生成紧凑且精准的反例集合来微调预训练的Hamilton-Jacobi值函数，从而获得更大的认证安全区域、更快的认证速度，并可在部署时通过屏蔽机制强制保证安全。
en_tdlr: A verification-guided training framework that uses probabilistic enumeration of safety constraints to generate compact, targeted counterexamples for fine-tuning pretrained Hamilton-Jacobi value functions, yielding larger certified safe regions, faster certification, and deployment-time safety shielding.
